title: Void Exp
description: This mod adds a lot content from TBoTV arg! (The Bottom of The Void)
body:
_Warning : This mod is based on the TBoTV ARG. I am not the creator of the ARG._

This mod adds a lot of content from this ARG!

**🧊 New Blocks : Noise Gem Block, Blood Obsidian
⛏️ New Tools : Dismantler, Repeller
🔥 And more in updates!**

_This is the first version of the mod, so it doesn't have a lot of content yet, but we are waiting for new updates to come!_
